trial_court: Judge, Family Court, Jagatsinghpur (C.P. No.84 of 2021 and C.P. No.245 of 2021)
case_name: Itishree Pradhan vs Subrat Ranjan Kapa
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of two proceedings from Judge, Family Court, Jagatsinghpur to Judge, Family Court, Cuttack due to her enrollment in a Coaching Institution at Cuttack.

legal_principles.principle: While hearing transfer applications for transfer of matrimonial cases, the convenience of the wife has to be looked at.
legal_principles.held: Law is well settled that, while hearing the transfer applications for transfer of matrimonial cases, the convenience of wife has to be looked at.
cited_cases: Itishree Pradhan vs Subrat Ranjan Kapa (2025)

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife has to be looked at while dealing with transfer petitions.
legal_principles.held: As it seems from the conduct of the Petitioner-wife, taking advantage of the leniency shown by the High Court so also Supreme Court that convenience of wife must be looked at while dealing with transfer petitions.
cited_cases: Itishree Pradhan vs Subrat Ranjan Kapa (2025)

outcome.final_order: Proceedings transferred from Judge, Family Court, Jagatsinghpur to Judge, Family Court, Cuttack.
